title: Degree-zero representatives for a filtered colimit on a fixed site
statement: Let $C$ be a small category and $P$ a precoverage containing isomorphisms, stable under composition and base change, with pullbacks along covering arrows. Assume every covering presieve of $P$ has finitely many arrows. Write $T=P^{\mathrm{Groth}}$ for the associated topology, and assume abelian sheafification and small Ext groups exist. Sheaves and object cohomology $H^0(X,A)$ have the meanings of [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $J$ be a small filtered category, $S:J\to\operatorname{Sh}(T,\mathrm{Ab})$ a functor, and $K$ a colimit cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then for every $X\in C$ and $y\in H^0(X,K.pt)$, there are $j\in J$ and $z\in H^0(X,S_j)$ such that $H^0(X,K_j)(z)=y$.

source.place: Tag 0738(4), fixed-site section comparison; abelian version Tag 03CO; degree-zero identification in Tag 09YP

proof.text: Compose Ext.homEquiv₀, the sheafification adjunction, the whiskered free-forgetful adjunction, and yonedaEquiv to identify H^0(X,A) with A(X). Naturality follows from mk₀_comp_mk₀ and homEquiv_naturality_right for the two adjunctions. This is implemented by the proved private equivalence and naturality lemma.
Apply siteFilteredColimit_sections_isIso to P, S, K and X. Surjectivity of the section comparison lifts the section corresponding to y.

Use Concrete.colimit_exists_rep to represent the lift at j. Apply the inverse degree-zero equivalence, its naturality and injectivity. The equation colimit.ι_desc identifies the resulting image with y.

theorem finiteCover_degreeZero_colimit_representatives
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (P : Precoverage C)
    [P.HasIsos] [P.IsStableUnderComposition] [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [P.HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : P ≤ Precoverage.finite C)
    [HasSheafify P.toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [HasExt.{u} (Sheaf P.toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    {J : Type u} [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J]
    (S : J ⥤ Sheaf P.toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (K : Cocone S) (hK : IsColimit K) (X : C) (y : Sheaf.H' K.pt 0 X) :
    ∃ (j : J) (z : Sheaf.H' (S.obj j) 0 X),
      ((((Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor P.toGrothendieck 0).map
        (K.ι.app j)).app (op X)).hom z) = y
